Abstract#

The first bridge dates to c. 1350 (date uncertain), as the city annals record1. A later survey disagrees2, and the annals are cited again for the flood of 14801.

Method#

We compared both sources against the map section and the archive copy.

References#

  1. Stadtarchiv Zürich, Annals, fol. 12v
  2. Survey of bridges, p. 42
  3. Hoffmann, Brücken, print edition only (no stable link).
